name: Salesforce Development
description: Build Salesforce apps and agents using these core building blocks: metadata, Apex, deploy/retrieve, security, reporting, and generated installed-versus-available capability discovery.
longDescription:
Ships **37 skills**, **2 agents**, **13 commands** and **3 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (37): `automation-flow-generate` (Generate Salesforce Flows using the MCP tool execute_metadata_action), `dx-code-analyzer-configure` (Set up, configure, and troubleshoot Salesforce Code Analyzer for any project), `dx-code-analyzer-custom-rule-create` (Create custom Code Analyzer rules for Regex (pattern matching), PMD (XPath/AST for Apex and metadata XML), and ESLint…), `dx-code-analyzer-run` (Run Salesforce Code Analyzer to scan code for security, performance, best practice, and code style violations), `dx-org-manage` (INVOKE this skill to execute Salesforce org operations: create scratch orgs, list/display/resume/delete scratch orgs, create org snapshots, open…), `dx-project-create` (Scaffold a brand-new Salesforce DX project from scratch — pick a template, generate the project, relocate this session…), `platform-apex-anonymous-run` (Use this skill to run anonymous Apex against the connected Salesforce org — from a .apex file or…), `platform-apex-generate` (Primary Apex authoring skill for class generation, refactoring, and review), and 29 more
- **Agents** (2): `architecture-review` (Reviews a Salesforce project against the Salesforce Well-Architected framework (Trusted / Easy / Adaptable)), `salesforce-dev` (Primary Salesforce development agent)
- **Commands** (13): `discover` (Show the six-stage journey signpost, run on-demand org feature detection, or find an uninstalled plugin that matches a…), `login` (Authenticate to a new Salesforce org via the browser (sf org login web)), `logout` (Sign out of one or all Salesforce orgs (sf org logout)), `org` (Show just the connected Salesforce org details — alias, edition, API version, instance URL, username), `plugin-install` (Confirm and install exactly one uninstalled plugin-catalog entry, or record an explicit decline), `plugin-recommendations` (Turn uninstalled-plugin recommendations on or off, tune how readily they trigger, or show current status), `project` (Show just the local SFDX project metadata stats — Apex/triggers/LWC/Aura/objects/perm sets/flows counts and git status), `reset-source-tracking` (Reset source tracking for the target org — tells the CLI to forget all tracked changes so the…), and 5 more
- **MCP servers** (3): `salesforce-api-context`, `salesforce-metadata-experts`, `salesforce-lsp`

Installs with `claude plugin install salesforce-development@claude-plugins-official` from `forcedotcom/sf-skills` (`plugins/builder/salesforce-development`).
